rules.sentence: Cellulitis is a superficial infection and will present as erythema and swelling to the affected portion of the body with no area of fluctuance.
A felon is a subcutaneous infection of the digital pulp space.
The area becomes warm, red, tense, and very painful due to the confinement of the infection, creating pressure in the individual compartments created by the septa of the finger pad.
These require excision and drainage, usually with a longitudinal incision and blunt dissection to ensure adequate drainage.
